title: From idea to
description: A clear process with no unnecessary words — from the first message to launch. You always know what is happening.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.description: You message us — share your business, goals, and expectations. We shape a clear vision of your future website together.

steps.title: Brief & Structure
steps.description: We define UX, sitemap, and technical requirements. We agree on the logic before creating the first design mockup.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We create a design tailored to your aesthetic. Every screen is thoughtful, approved, and ready for development.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: We build fast and clean. Responsive design, SEO, optimization, and integrations are included by default.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.description: We test, launch, and show you how to manage everything. We stay in touch — you are not alone after release.
